userText: I wake up at 7 oclock and brush my teeth. Then I eat breakfast with my family.
aiRevision: Every morning, I wake up at 7 o'clock, brush my teeth, and eat breakfast with my family — it's a simple but happy free-expression time for me.
errorSentences: 未使用目标词'free expression'，整句仅描述日常作息，与'free-expression'主题无关；A2学习者需尝试在语境中自然融入目标短语，如表达个人感受、选择或创意活动。
suggestions: A2阶段可以尝试用简单方式关联'free expression'，比如：'At school, we have free expression time — I draw or tell stories.' 这样既符合水平，又紧扣主题。

userText: Yesterday I go to the park with my friend. We play basketball and was very happy.
aiRevision: Yesterday I went to the park with my friend. We played basketball and were very happy.
errorSentences: 动词时态错误：'go' 和 'play' 应使用过去式 'went' 和 'played'；'was' 主语不一致，应为 'we were'；缺少主语一致性检查。
suggestions: A1 学习者需掌握规则动词过去式（-ed）和常见不规则动词（如 go→went, play→played），并注意主谓一致（we were，不是 was）。建议多练习‘Yesterday/I/He/She + 过去式动词’句型。

userText: I like coffee very much. Every morning I drink one cup before go to work.
aiRevision: I really like coffee. Every morning, I drink one cup before going to work.
errorSentences: 'before go to work' 语法错误：介词 before 后需接动名词（going），不能接动词原形；
整段未体现目标词 'free expression'——该任务要求围绕'自由表达'主题展开，但句子仅描述日常习惯，缺乏个人观点、情感或创造性表达；
词汇过于基础且重复（like, drink, cup, work），未使用与'自由表达'相关的词汇（如 think, feel, share, express, idea, opinion 等）
suggestions: A1 学习者可尝试用简单句表达自己的想法或感受，例如：'I feel happy when I draw.' 或 'I like to say what I think.' 这样更贴近 free expression 主题。不必追求复杂句子，但要让内容与主题相关。

userText: My daily routine is simple. I wake up early, do exercise, and reading news.
aiRevision: My daily routine is simple: I wake up early, do exercise, and read the news.
errorSentences: 动词形式不一致：'do exercise'（一般现在时）与 'reading news'（动名词，语法错误）并列，应统一为动词原形（and read...）；缺少冠词：'read the news'，不可数名词'news'前需加定冠词；未体现目标词'free expression'——题目要求在'free-expression'场景下使用该短语，但句子中完全未出现，也未通过内容体现自由表达的主题（如表达观点、创意、情感等）
suggestions: A1学习者应尝试用简单句表达个人想法或喜好，以体现'free expression'。例如：'I like to draw freely. It makes me happy.' 这样既用了基础词汇，又自然融入了自由表达的概念。不必追求复杂句，但需紧扣主题词。

userText: Last weekend I visit my grandmother. She cook delicious food for me.
aiRevision: Last weekend I visited my grandmother. She cooked delicious food for me.
errorSentences: 动词时态错误：'visit' 和 'cook' 应使用过去式 'visited' 和 'cooked'，因为时间状语 'Last weekend' 表明动作发生在过去。
未体现目标词 'free expression'——该句是简单记叙，缺乏个人感受、观点或创造性表达，不符合 'free-expression' 场景要求。
suggestions: A1 学习者可尝试在简单句中加入一点点个人表达，比如：'Last weekend I visited my grandmother. She cooked delicious food for me, and I felt very happy!' 这样既保持语法正确，又开始练习自由表达情感，更贴合任务目标。

userText: I usually takes the bus to work. It is cheap but sometime very crowded.
aiRevision: I usually take the bus to work. It's cheap, but sometimes it's very crowded.
errorSentences: 主谓不一致：'I usually takes' 应为 'I usually take'；冠词和代词缺失：'sometime' 是副词误写，应为 'sometimes'，且后半句缺少主语和动词形式（'it's very crowded'）；未体现目标短语 'free expression'——该句属日常陈述，无个人观点、情感或创造性表达，偏离自由表达场景要求。
suggestions: A1 学习者可尝试在简单句中加入一点点个人感受，比如 'I like it because I can look out the window and think freely.' 这样就更贴近 'free expression' 的精神——不是用这个词组本身，而是通过内容展现自由表达。当前句子语法基本可懂，但需先修正动词形式和常用副词，并逐步加入小句表达想法。

userText: In the evening I watch TV with my wife. We likes comedy shows best.
aiRevision: In the evening, I watch TV with my wife. We love comedy shows the most.
errorSentences: 主谓一致错误：'We likes' 应为 'We like'；'best' 作程度副词时通常与 'the' 连用，即 'the best'，但更自然的表达是 'love ... the most'；未体现目标词 'free expression' —— 整个句子未涉及思想、情感、创意等自由表达主题，仅描述日常习惯
suggestions: 这个句子语法基本正确（除动词单复数外），但完全未体现‘free expression’（自由表达）这一核心主题。A1 学习者可用简单句表达想法，例如：'I draw pictures to show my feelings.' 或 'I tell stories to my friends.' 请尝试用一个句子说出你如何自由表达自己——哪怕只用 I + verb + noun 结构，也比单纯描述习惯更切题。

userText: Tomorrow I will go to supermarket buy some vegetables and fruits for dinner.
aiRevision: Tomorrow I will go to the supermarket to buy some vegetables and fruits for dinner.
errorSentences: 缺少定冠词 'the'（supermarket 前需加 'the'）
动词不定式结构不完整：'go to supermarket buy...' 应改为 'go to the supermarket to buy...' 或 'go to the supermarket and buy...'；A1 水平应掌握 'to + 动词原形' 表目的
未体现目标词 'free expression'——本题为 free-expression 场景，但句子是机械套用模板的购物句，缺乏个人想法、情感或真实交际意图，不符合自由表达要求
suggestions: A1 学习者可尝试在简单句中加入一点点个人表达，例如：'I like cooking, so tomorrow I will go to the supermarket to buy vegetables and fruits for dinner.' 这样既符合语法基础，又体现了‘自由表达’——说出自己的喜好和原因。不必追求复杂，但要有‘我’的声音。

userText: My English is not good but I practice everyday. I want speak more fluent.
aiRevision: My English isn’t very good yet, but I practice every day. I want to speak more fluently.
errorSentences: 动词 want 后应接带 to 的不定式（want to speak），原句漏掉 to；'more fluent' 是形容词，修饰动词 speak 应用副词 fluently；'everyday' 是形容词（如 everyday life），此处表‘每天’应为副词 every day；'is not good' 可优化为更自然的 isn’t very good yet，体现进步意愿
suggestions: A1 学习者可安全使用简单现在时和基础目标表达。建议牢记 want to do 结构，并区分 every day（副词短语）与 everyday（形容词）。当前尝试已体现积极表达意愿，值得鼓励！

userText: After dinner I usually walk my dog in the park near my home. It make me relax.
aiRevision: After dinner, I usually walk my dog in the park near my home. It helps me relax.
errorSentences: 主谓不一致：'It make me relax' 应为 'It makes me relax'；'helps me relax' 比 'make me relax' 更自然常用，且符合A1常用动词搭配。
未体现目标短语 'free expression' —— 本题为 free-expression 场景下的自由表达任务，但句子仅描述日常行为，未展现个人感受、观点或创造性表达，偏离任务要求。
suggestions: A1 学习者可尝试在简单句后加一句表达感受或想法，例如：'I feel happy and free when I walk there.' 这样既保持语言简单，又自然融入 'free expression' 的核心——表达真实情感和主观体验。
